viewing_check: Photograph the console underside (serial, PAL label), check the box end label and condition, open the lid for disc tray and laser, look for battery or capacitor leakage on any visible board, check the controller buttons and cable, and confirm what the round pad item is. Ask if it can be powered on; also check whether the box is the original retail box or a plain carton with a printed end.
